"use client"

import type { ReactNode, Ref } from "react"
import type { AutoFormFieldProps } from "@autoform/react"
import { useFieldContext } from "@autoform/react/tanstack-form"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"

interface SelectInputProps {
  "aria-invalid"?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  placeholder?: ReactNode
  ref?: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>
}

export function SelectField({ inputProps, error, id, parsedField }: AutoFormFieldProps) {
  const field = useFieldContext<string>()
  const { ref, disabled, placeholder, "aria-invalid": ariaInvalid } = inputProps as SelectInputProps
  return <Select disabled={disabled} name={field.name} value={field.state.value ?? ""} onValueChange={(value) => { if (value !== null) field.handleChange(value) }}>
    <SelectTrigger id={id} ref={ref} aria-invalid={ariaInvalid} onBlur={field.handleBlur} className={error ? "border-destructive" : ""}><SelectValue placeholder={placeholder ?? "Select an option"} /></SelectTrigger>
    <SelectContent>{(parsedField.options ?? []).map(([value, label]) => <SelectItem key={String(value)} value={String(value)}>{label}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
  </Select>
}
